description.value: The Sidney Pier Hotel is a contemporary seven-storey waterfront hotel situated on Sidney's vibrant harbour, designed around coastal aesthetics and the natural rhythm of the Salish Sea. The property includes an on-site farm-to-table restaurant (10 Acres at The Pier) and a full-service spa and salon (Haven Spa & Salon) that has served the community for over 15 years. Sidney's coastal cycling routes are highlighted by the hotel as a local attraction, making it a natural base for touring cyclists exploring the Saanich Peninsula.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack (8 spaces) at 63m; rack (8 spaces, covered) at 65m; stands (5 spaces) at 71m; rack (5 spaces) at 82m. Total: 26 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the hotel is open and operational, showing active booking functionality, multiple room types, an on-site restaurant (10 Acres at The Pier), and Haven Spa & Salon. No bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, laundry, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website. OSM tags note internet_access=wlan but the website does not confirm Wi-Fi explicitly. The website page title reads 'Sidney Pier Hotel' without '& Spa', suggesting a possible name discrepancy with the OSM record.
concerns: OSM name is 'The Sidney Pier Hotel & Spa' but the website page title reads 'Sidney Pier Hotel' — the spa on-site is branded separately as 'Haven Spa & Salon', suggesting the '& Spa' suffix may no longer be part of the hotel's official name.
